admin.title: Product bundles
admin.lead: Offer two or more products as a discounted bundle; the discount only applies while every product of the bundle is in the cart.
admin.empty_text: Create the first bundle with the form on the right.
admin.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. “starter-bundle”.
admin.products_hint: Pick at least two different products and a billing cycle for each.
admin.discount_hint: Percentage off every product of the bundle (0–100).
admin.delete_confirm: Delete the bundle? A coupon already used is only deactivated.
admin.bad_slug: The slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
admin.bad_discount: The discount must be above 0 and at most 100.
admin.two_products: A bundle needs at least two different products.
admin.duplicate_product: A product cannot be in a bundle twice.
